paper_title: Towards an electrostatic storage ring for fundamental physics measurements
notes: Projection paper for a table-top electrostatic storage ring. Fig.4 shows projected axion-electron coupling (left) and axion-nucleon coupling (right) sensitivities over mass range 1e-19 to 1e-9 eV. No numerical data tables or readable digitized values provided in the text. Pre-analysis hint was AxionEDM, but the dark matter exclusion plots are for axion-electron and axion-nucleon couplings; the primary first-stage DM search is axion-electron. Could not extract numerical (mass, coupling) pairs. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Left panel of Fig 4 shows g_aee vs m_a. The existing experimental bounds (comagnetometer, torsion, long-range) form a jagged lower exclusion boundary around g_aee ~ 5e-6 GeV^-1 across most of the mass range. The colored lines (blue 1s, red 5h) are projected sensitivities, not exclusions. Data points trace the gray existing-bound boundary which is the actual exclusion.
